✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: lgtm!

To allow partially correct solutions to grab a bit more points, you could probably add a less steep progression of examples. For example:

- Test/pair 1 (lowercase match only, space separators only around the word): The hitchhiker is going on the mountain to walk, as any hitchhiker would do.
- Test/pair 2 (lowercase match only, more separators): The hitchiker's guide to the galaxy is a decent book.
- Test/pair 3 (title and lowercase match): Hitchhiker Joe and hitchhiker Ben are grabbing a bite at random shop number three.
- Test/pair 4 (exotic cases): Cat is a word that has multiple signification. For example, cat is just the animal, CAT is actually a vehicle, and CaT is just bonkers.

This is all optional of course :)

Goal
* Please change "sentence" to "string" as [[S]] isn't necessarily a sentence in all cases.

* Please format "cat", "Cat", "CAT", ".", ",", "!" and "?" as {{constants}}.

* Please remove all quotation marks.

* Please change "Punctuation marks" to "Non-letter characters".

Input
* Please change "sentence" to "string" as explained above.

Constraints
* Please change "len(s)" to "length of [[S]]".

* Please change 500 to 100.

* Please change "len(w)" to "length of [[W]]".

* Please change 50 to 10.

* Please add "lowercase" before "letters".

Cases
* Please note that each test and its validator should cover the same scenario. Therefore, please revise the cases as described below.

* Test 1: Please add "and then sees the Pink Panther" after "dog".

* Validator 1: Please remove "!" from [[S]].

* Validator 2
  • Please change [[W]] to "meme".

  • Please change [[S]] to contain more instances of "meme" with different letter cases.

* Test 3: Please revise the case so that the output is 0.

* Test 4 and Validator 4: Please rewrite the cases so that [[S]] appears in [[W]], attached to non-letter characters and in different letter cases.

* Please add Test 5 and Validator 5, where [[W]] is a single character and appears multiple times in [[S]], both alone and as part of a longer word.

* Please add Test 6 and Validator 6, where [[W]] is not found in [[S]].

* Please add Test 7 and Validator 7, where [[S]] is the same as [[W]] but with a different letter case.

Thanks.
The author's account has been deactivated, so I've taken the liberty of revising the statement and the cases.

Thank you for your suggestion! I've just added a pair of cases called "Just lowercase" and also moved "Single word", "Single-letter target" and "Not found" earlier, which should provide a slightly gentler progression. There are now 10 case pairs in total, so I'm hesitant to add any more.

Validator 1 tests something test 1 doesn't (mixed case), maybe replace the test 1 with:

"The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy is not about a normal hitchhiker but a hitchhiker in space"

Otherwise, definitely better! And thanks for taking over the contribution :)

In Test 1, we have "The" and "the".
